question: Which NSSTS company positions are confirmed, which are educated guesses, and which have evidence against them?
answer: Of the 182 company positions on the NSSTS map, 139 are labelled confirmed, 42 are educated guesses (28 strong inference, 13 supported inference, 1 plausible fit) and 1 is blocked or contradicted; 39 positions cite evidence against themselves, 33 of them still labelled confirmed.
